blockingIssues.description: `-g` regex matching is evaluated against normalized display paths (`display_path_for`) instead of baseline raw traversal paths, causing parity regressions for patterns that depend on leading `./` (e.g., '^\./rust-ag/src/main\.rs$').

appliedUpdates.description: Added stream-mode parity notes to .factory/library/architecture.md for `-c -v` invert counting and byte-tolerant stdin handling expectations.
Added `-g` baseline semantics note to .factory/library/architecture.md: regex matches raw paths, while output paths are normalized only at print time.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: When modifying `-g` output formatting, require explicit parity guards that verify filename-regex matching semantics on raw paths (including `^\./...$` patterns), not only display formatting assertions.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Review failure in rust-cli-filename-filter-path-prefix-fix showed formatting-only tests passed while regex matching semantics regressed.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: After fixing CLI regressions (e.g., invalid `-G` and non-UTF8 context behavior), require corresponding shared parity-matrix scenario coverage updates when gaps are identified.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Review of rust-cli-context-color-filter-help-version-fix noted shared matrix scenarios still only cover valid `-G` and UTF-8 context cases.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Enforce red-first workflow adherence in reported skill feedback (or add automated transcript-order checks) so implementation-before-test ordering cannot be marked as procedure-followed.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Review of rust-cli-filename-filter-path-prefix-fix observed source edits before new tests while skill feedback still reported followedProcedure=true.
